requirements.label: Introductory Creative Writing Prerequisite
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: RCCWLIT 220, RCCWLIT 221, or RCCWLIT 325, or an approved equivalent.

requirements.label: Creative Writing Courses: 3 at 300-Level or Above
requirements.hint: Creative writing seminar or tutorial courses (RCCWLIT) at the 300 level or above.

requirements.label: Additional Creative Writing Course
requirements.hint: One more creative writing seminar or tutorial course (RCCWLIT), any level, beyond the prerequisite. Must be a distinct course beyond the prerequisite and the three 300 level workshop courses (offset applied).

requirements.label: Literature Written Prior to 1600
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. One literature course must focus on literature written prior to 1600, meaning ancient or medieval literature. Per the RC curriculum page and the LSA bulletin, the course may cover non-Western or Western literature, but a Western course must pre-date the Shakespearean era, and ENGLISH 367 (Shakespeare's Plays) does not fulfill it. The RC publishes only examples (such as ENGLISH 350, CLCIV 385, and MEMS 386), not a complete list. Until then, confirm progress with your advisor.

requirements.label: Additional Courses in Literature: 4 at 300-Level or Higher
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. Four more literature courses at the 300 level or higher, distinct from the pre 1600 course, for 5 literature courses total. Per the RC curriculum page and the LSA bulletin, any course with a literature focus can qualify, each must be at least 3 credits, and students are encouraged to look in RC Arts and Ideas, English, and Comparative Literature; the published course lists are past examples, not a complete list. Second language majors may count one upper level literature course in that language with advisor approval. Until then, confirm progress with your advisor.

requirements.label: Major Total Credits: minimum 28
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. Minimum 28 credits from all courses used toward the major (4 creative writing courses plus 5 advisor-approved literature courses; prerequisites excluded). The literature portion has no published course list, so this total cannot be counted automatically. Until then, confirm progress with your advisor.
